dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - PostgreSQL - APM Correlation
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard that compares backend transaction latency with PostgreSQL spans, database time, wait events, and trace context. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: APM and database correlation
pages.description: Move from slow backend transactions to PostgreSQL contribution and trace evidence.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration), average(databaseDuration), percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95), max(duration) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND db.system = 'postgresql' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(databaseDuration), average(duration), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND db.system = 'postgresql' FACET db.operation, db.collection LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(total_wait_time_ms), count(*) FROM PostgresWaitEvents WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET wait_category, wait_event_name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Trace IDs with slow database spans

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(traceId), percentile(duration, 95), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND db.system = 'postgresql' FACET name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Start with transaction/database time, open a slow transaction trace, then compare PostgreSQL spans and wait-event categories for the same period.
